text:
Priya: Heads-up: discovered a UX hazard with saved views + model pins. If someone saves a view while a model is pinned, the saved object currently toggles that pin on load and can change routing without explicit consent.
Dax: Yikes. We had a support ticket where a saved view bumped production token spend because users loaded it on prod.
Linh: Proposal: introduce a "Preview mode" on load. Loading a saved query should never change routing by default. Instead show a read-only simulated breadcrumb: model preference, estimated cost delta, and latency sketch.
Carlos: Love simulation. For Dedicated customers we also need an explicit consent modal when preview suggests applying a model that increases cost or lacks required certs. That modal should require the route-owner or an approver.
Priya: UX sketch: small banner at top: "Previewing saved view (preferred model: redwood/neo-13b-q3). This will not change routing. [Preview cost: +$2.30 per 1k tokens] [Apply to route]". Apply triggers a modal with audit text and checkbox agree.
Dax: On API side: savedQueries should gain attributes: preferred_model (string|null), preview_metadata (string json encoded), and a flag immutable: force_apply (bool) which must be true to auto-apply on import. We should default force_apply=false and reject true for non-admin creators.
Linh: Telemetry: emit saved_query.load with tags {mode: preview|apply, preferred_model_present: true|false, cost_delta_usd: "0.00"}. Also saved_query.apply.requested and saved_query.apply.completed with result tags.
Carlos: For console performance, we should run a server-side quick-estimate for cost and p95 using cached model profiles. Client fetches estimate with one cheap endpoint: /saved_queries/:id/preview_estimate. Avoid full route simulation on load.
Priya: Edge-case: archived models. If preferred_model is not in catalog, show "Model unavailable" and let preview use the route default. Telemetry: saved_query.load.missing_model=true.
Dax: Implementation note: savedQuery DB row should keep preferred_model_id (nullable) and preview_blob (small JSON string). Keep row size tiny so listing queries remains cheap.
Linh: Ops-bot: feature branch saved-query-preview deployed to staging :white_check_mark:. Please test the modal flow and the estimate endpoint.
Carlos: I'll add an acceptance test that ensures loading a saved query with preferred_model does not call route.update unless user presses apply.
Priya: TL;DR: default non-destructive loads, preview estimates endpoint, consent modal for apply, telemetry keys + missing-model handling. I'll add to the PM spec.
